title: A flat resolution whose ringed-topos pullback is K-flat
statement: Let $(C,J)$ and $(D,K)$ be sites essentially small in a fixed coefficient universe, let $R$ on $C$ and $S$ on $D$ be sheaves of commutative rings, and let $u^{-1}\dashv u_*$ be a morphism of their sheaf topoi, with $u^{-1}$ preserving finite limits. Fix its algebraic inverse image on ring and module sheaves and a ring homomorphism $c:u^{-1}R\to S$. Write $u^*$ for the additive module pullback, inverse image followed by extension of scalars [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category, def-pur-sheaf-tensor-product], applied termwise to cochain complexes [def-pc-cochain-complex-modules]. For every complex $P$ of $R$-module sheaves, without flatness or K-flatness hypotheses on $P$, there exist a complex $L$ and a quasi-isomorphism $q:L\to P$ [def-pc-quasi-iso-modules] such that $L$ is K-flat [def-pc-kflat-complex], each term of $L$ is flat [def-pc-flat-sheaf-modules], and $u^*L$ is K-flat.

proof.text: Construct a functorial flat cover by sheafifying the free presheaf on the underlying presheaf of sets of a module sheaf. Its evaluation is sectionwise surjective, hence epi after sheafification. Sectionwise tensor with a free module preserves finite limits; the monoidal sheafification comparison transports this to the sheaf cover. Tensor colimit preservation from [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits] supplies finite colimits. This proves HasFunctorialFlatResolution with an explicit free-presheaf cover and no unproved existence choice. Apply the proved source-library reduced Abelian.LeftResolution.resolutionFunctor directly to P, with its resolutionNatTrans augmentation q. Exact integer-indexed colimits of module sheaves give QuasiIso q. The proved colimitOfShapeFlatResolutionFunctorObj supplies the actual integer-indexed filtered colimit presentation by bounded-above categorically flat complexes. No separate public existence statement is introduced.

Install the sheaf tensor comparisons and coefficient-sized tensor colimit preservation of [lem-weil-pbc-independent-sheaf-tensor-colimits]. Exact integer-indexed colimits follow by HasExactColimitsOfShape.domain_of_functor from the underlying abelian-sheaf functor and AB5 for abelian groups. Use the proved source-library LeftResolution.kFlat_resolutionFunctor_obj to obtain categorical K-flatness of L directly. Apply this tensor quasi-isomorphism preservation to the map 0→Z for an arbitrary acyclic test complex Z: the source tensor is zero, so the target tensor is acyclic. This is precisely IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients. CochainComplex.closedUnderColimitsOfShape_flat applied to each evaluation cocone gives flat terms of L; siteSheafTensorRightIso converts the categorical condition to IsFlatOnSite.

The specified module pullback preserves coefficient-sized filtered colimits by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-pullback-filtered-colimits]. Enlarge the integer order category with ULiftHomULiftCategory.equiv and transport preservation back to ℤ. Thus its complex functor preserves the displayed colimit presentation. Each image stage is bounded above, since additivity preserves its zero terms. Its terms are flat by [lem-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-flat-module-pullback]; the explicit ULift-triviality comparison turns the supplied AlgebraicInverseImage into the universe-explicit presentation required there. Apply the same source-library bounded-flat criterion, filtered-colimit closure, and acyclic-test conversion on the destination site. This proves independent-coefficient K-flatness of uStar(L). At the flat-pullback call, rewrite with hobj and use direct definitional conversion between changeOfRings and changeOfRingsOfUniverses in equal coefficient universes; no separate equality theorem or downstream import is needed.

theorem exists_pullback_adapted_flat_resolution
    {C : Type uC} {D : Type uD} [Category.{vC} C] [Category.{vD} D]
    [EssentiallySmall.{w} C] [EssentiallySmall.{w} D]
    {JC : GrothendieckTopology C} {JD : GrothendieckTopology D}
    {R : Sheaf JC CommRingCat.{w}} {S RI : Sheaf JD CommRingCat.{w}}
    (uInv : Sheaf JC (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JD (Type (w)))
    (uPush : Sheaf JD (Type (w)) ⥤ Sheaf JC (Type (w)))
    (adj : uInv ⊣ uPush) [PreservesFiniteLimits uInv]
    (I : AlgebraicInverseImage uInv R RI) (c : RI ⟶ S)
    (uStar : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R) ⥤
      ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JD
        (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj S))
    (hobj : ∀ M : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R),
      uStar.obj M = changeOfRings c (I.modules.obj M))
    (hmap : ∀ {M N : ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)} (a : M ⟶ N),
      uStar.map a = eqToHom (hobj M) ≫
        changeOfRingsHom c (I.modules.obj M) (I.modules.map a) ≫ eqToHom (hobj N).symm)
    [uStar.Additive]
    (P : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ) :
    ∃ (L : CochainComplex (ringedSiteModules.{w} ((sheafCompose JC
      (forget₂ CommRingCat.{w} RingCat.{w})).obj R)) ℤ) (q : L ⟶ P),
      L.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients ∧
      (∀ n : ℤ, IsFlatOnSite (J := JC) (R := R) (L.X n)) ∧ QuasiIso q ∧
      CochainComplex.IsKFlatIndependentCoefficients
        ((uStar.mapHomologicalComplex (ComplexShape.up ℤ)).obj L)
